description: API Lambda handlers: Project CRUD, slide generation trigger, version retrieval, approval, video generation trigger, job status, and deliverables listing with Idempotency-Key support
steps: In lambdas/api/src/handlers/projects.ts, implement POST /v1/projects handler: validates request body (title, theme, audience, duration, urls[]), generates projectId (ULID), creates DynamoDB item with userId (from Cognito sub in event.requestContext.authorizer), status DRAFT, createdAt. Returns 201 with projectId.

In lambdas/api/src/handlers/slides.ts, implement POST /v1/projects/{id}/slides handler: validates project ownership, checks Idempotency-Key header, starts Content State Machine execution (Step Functions) with input {projectId, userId, theme, audience, duration, urls}. Creates Job record in DynamoDB. Returns 202 with jobId.

In lambdas/api/src/handlers/versions.ts, implement GET /v1/projects/{id}/versions/{version} handler: validates ownership, reads deck.md from S3 (versions/v{NNNN}/deck.md), returns markdown content and metadata (status, slideCount, createdAt).

In lambdas/api/src/handlers/approve.ts, implement POST /v1/projects/{id}/versions/{version}/approve handler: validates ownership, validates version is in SLIDE_READY state, transitions to SLIDE_APPROVED in DynamoDB, returns 200.

In lambdas/api/src/handlers/videos.ts, implement POST /v1/projects/{id}/videos handler: validates project ownership, validates version is SLIDE_APPROVED, checks Idempotency-Key, starts video generation Step Functions execution. Creates Job record. Returns 202 with jobId.

In lambdas/api/src/handlers/jobs.ts, implement GET /v1/jobs/{jobId} handler: reads Job from DynamoDB, returns {jobId, projectId, status, progress (stage-specific message from design section 14 state mapping), error, createdAt, updatedAt}.

In lambdas/api/src/handlers/deliverables.ts, implement GET /v1/projects/{id}/deliverables handler: validates ownership, queries S3 for available artifacts in the version prefix, generates presigned URLs (15 min expiry) for each deliverable. Returns array of {type: 'pdf'|'pptx'|'mp4'|'vtt'|'srt', filename, url, size, createdAt}.

In lambdas/api/src/middleware/, implement shared middleware: Cognito auth extraction (userId from sub claim), Idempotency-Key check against DynamoDB (conditional put with key as partition key), request validation with zod schemas, error response formatting (4xx/5xx with structured error body).

In lambdas/api/src/db/, implement DynamoDB operations: ProjectRepository (create, get, updateStatus), VersionRepository (create, get, approve), JobRepository (create, get, updateProgress), IdempotencyRepository (putIfAbsent, get). Use @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb and @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb.
Write unit tests for each handler with mocked DynamoDB and S3 clients: test authorization checks, idempotency behavior, state transition validation, error responses
acceptance_criteria: POST /v1/projects creates a project and returns 201 with projectId
POST /v1/projects/{id}/slides returns 202 and creates a Job record
GET /v1/projects/{id}/versions/{version} returns deck markdown and metadata
POST /v1/projects/{id}/videos validates SLIDE_APPROVED state before starting
GET /v1/jobs/{jobId} returns progress with stage-specific messages
GET /v1/projects/{id}/deliverables returns presigned URLs for available artifacts
Idempotency-Key prevents duplicate job creation (same key returns same response)
All API handler unit tests pass
verification: Run pnpm test to confirm all API handler tests pass
Run pnpm build to confirm TypeScript compilation succeeds
